concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3a (T012a, T013a, T015, T035, T036, T037)
concerns.text: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, SC-001, and US-001 require the generation of `entropy_results.csv`, `convergence_results_core.csv`, and the execution of survival analysis. Tasks T012a, T013a, T015, T035, T036, and T037 are marked as unchecked `[ ]` or `[~]`. Without these tasks being marked as implemented/executed, the primary scientific hypothesis (SC-001) has no path to verification.

FR-004, FR-006, SC-002, and US-002 require the implementation of a logistic regression router, non-inferiority testing, and FLOPs savings calculation. Tasks T019, T019b, T020, T021a, and T021b are marked as unchecked `[ ]` or `[x]` (T020, T021a, T021b are checked but depend on unchecked T019/T019b). The core implementation tasks for the router (T019) are incomplete, leaving the 'So what?' utility unaddressed.

FR-005, FR-007, SC-003, SC-004, and US-003 require Holm-Bonferroni correction, mixed-effects modeling for underpowered strata, and sensitivity sweeps. Tasks T025a, T025b, T025d, T025f, and T026 are marked as unchecked `[ ]` or `[~]`. The plan's robustness checks are not covered by executable tasks.

FR-001 requires an 'unseen' validation set strictly disjoint from the test set. Tasks T004g (Generate Unseen Validation Set) and T004h (Verify Set Disjointness) are marked as unchecked `[ ]` or `[X]` (T004h is checked but T004g is not). The prerequisite data artifact `unseen_validation_set.csv` is not generated by a completed task, blocking the entropy calculation.
SC-005 and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) require `quickstart.md` to document CPU/GPU modes. Task T030 is marked as unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the reproducibility path unverified.

Task T013b is marked `[~]` (incomplete/ambiguous) but is a prerequisite for T025c and T026 (Sensitivity Analysis). The status marker is inconsistent with the requirement to have a complete task list for the stage.

Task T037 is marked `[~]` (incomplete/ambiguous) despite being a critical execution step for the survival analysis (FR-003). The status marker should be `[ ]` (pending) or `[x]` (done) to clearly indicate coverage status.
